process.title: 实现 nthprime.py 第 n 个素数与 tests/test_nthprime.py
process.scope: Owns only nthprime.py and tests/test_nthprime.py. Does not touch dijkstra, windscale, any existing file, or any team/** path. Stdlib only; must not import the other two modules.
process.task:
Create nthprime.py (new file only, do not modify any existing file) implementing the work order's nth-prime spec, plus tests/test_nthprime.py covering every acceptance item.

Spec (verbatim requirements):
- nth_prime(n: int) -> int: 1-based counting (the 1st prime is 2). n must be int (bool rejected); non-int raises TypeError; n < 1 raises ValueError.

Acceptance items (each needs a corresponding test case, transcribed exactly):
- nth_prime(1) == 2; nth_prime(2) == 3; nth_prime(3) == 5; nth_prime(4) == 7; nth_prime(5) == 11; nth_prime(6) == 13; nth_prime(10) == 29; nth_prime(25) == 97; nth_prime(50) == 229; nth_prime(100) == 541; nth_prime(1000) == 7919.
- nth_prime(0), nth_prime(-3) raise ValueError.
- nth_prime(2.0), nth_prime("3"), nth_prime(True) raise TypeError.

Deliverables: only nthprime.py and tests/test_nthprime.py (both new; never edit existing files). Standard library only.
